operations.command: set -e; iptables -A OUTPUT -p tcp --syn -j REJECT; iptables -A OUTPUT -p udp --dport 53 -j REJECT; if timeout 20 curl -sSI https://cache.nixos.org >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo reachable; exit 1; fi; printf network-cut
cd /etc/nixos && printf 'testpass123\ntestpass123\n' | nixosctl install --format --yes >/tmp/offline-install.log 2>&1 && printf installed || { tail -60 /tmp/offline-install.log; exit 1; }

set -e; grep -q 'installing the system baked into this installer' /tmp/offline-install.log; if grep -q 'github:nix-community/disko' /tmp/offline-install.log; then echo fetched-disko; exit 1; fi; printf used-prebuilt
set -e; test -f /mnt/etc/nixos/flake.nix; btrfs subvolume list /mnt | grep -F '@snapshots/@root/CLEAN' >/dev/null; printf clean-snapshots
